review_method: Sequential inline skill review, as required by the user AGENTS tool mapping; no independent reviewer coverage.

resolutions.title: Native and live acceptance harnesses are missing
resolutions.resolution: Added an isolated optional-feature WebdriverIO desktop harness, explicit opt-in Google live integration suite, and Mac/Windows CI with cross-platform backup restoration. Mac workflow passes; Windows and live Google remain unverified pending external prerequisites.

resolutions.title: Imported baseline orders overflow renderer integers
resolutions.resolution: Imported report-date cash anchors use a portable 32-bit sequence; automatic transaction order excludes baseline anchors. Rust rejects event orders outside the exact JavaScript integer range. Tests cover both Excel date epochs, baseline import and native JSON ordering.

resolutions.title: Preview can outlive a changed transaction draft
resolutions.resolution: Disable entry fields, import allocations, modal closure and background navigation while an operation is pending. Delayed-preview and import preparation component tests verify the lock.

resolutions.title: Missing legacy facts silently become USD calls
resolutions.resolution: Reject missing currency, unknown direction or unknown option right rather than guessing economic facts. Real workbook regression fixtures verify each rejection.

resolutions.title: Source changes retain incompatible cycle filters
resolutions.resolution: Clear cycle/account/currency filters and expanded positions when selecting a different source. Component test verifies incompatible filters do not survive dataset replacement.

resolutions.title: Overview omits contributed capital totals
resolutions.resolution: Show net external contributions and net capital allocated in the native-currency overview alongside position P/L and the growth chart.
